name: garage-kit
description: A household car-maintenance app you deploy to your own Cloudflare account, set up and researched with your own Claude.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/configure.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.demo: node scripts/configure.mjs --local --mock-ai && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/secrets.mjs --local && node scripts/seed-demo.mjs && wrangler dev
